title: Race Distance
statement:
By the sporting regulations, a Grand Prix is the **fewest whole laps** whose total distance is **at least 305 km** (305000 metres).

Given the length of one lap of a circuit in metres, print how many laps the race will have.

(In real life Monaco gets an exception. Not here!)
input_format: One integer `L`, the lap length in metres.
output_format: One integer, the number of laps.

examples.explanation: Bahrain: 56 laps cover only 303.072 km, so the race needs 57 laps (308.484 km).
